summary: A change notice for IMP system version 2513. The delay before a host just coming up may send messages through the IMP was lengthened, and IMPs gained the ability to test their host interfaces under Network Control Center control, to help locate faults.

plainLanguage.summary: BBN announces two changes in IMP system version 2513. Hosts must wait longer before sending after startup, and the Network Control Center can test host interfaces to help locate faults.

questions: how long must a host wait before sending
subtitle: IMP system version 2513 lengthens host startup delay and adds interface testing.

tldr.problem: The IMP system needed a longer startup interval before hosts could send and a way for the NCC to test faulty host interfaces.
tldr.mechanism: Version 2513 delays host messages for 40 seconds to 1 minute 15 seconds after startup and enables NCC-controlled tests of host interfaces.
tldr.outcome: The IMP could allow more startup time and help operators isolate host-interface communication faults.

today: RFC 256 is an IMP system change notice published in November 1971. The unit metadata lists its status as Unknown.

sections.title: Host Startup Delay
sections.content: Version 2513 changes how long a host is prevented from sending messages into the network after it comes alive. The new interval is between 40 seconds and one minute 15 seconds, replacing the previous interval of between 30 seconds and one minute.
sections.plainLanguage: A host must wait longer after coming alive before sending messages. The new waiting period is between 40 seconds and one minute 15 seconds.

sections.title: Host Interface Testing
sections.content: The IMP gained the ability to test its host interfaces under control of the Network Control Center. BBN says the test can help isolate trouble when the communication path between an IMP and its host is faulty.
sections.plainLanguage: The Network Control Center can ask the IMP to test its connection to a host. The test is intended to help operators locate communication problems.

sections.title: Version 2513
sections.content: The notice says the new IMP system version would be installed shortly or might already have been installed when the notice was read. It identifies the startup delay and interface test as the two principal changes.
sections.plainLanguage: This notice describes two changes planned for IMP version 2513. It does not give additional implementation details.
